exposure: Fifth minute Appearance, Pulse, Grimace, Activity, Respiration (APGAR score)
finding: The incidence of respiratory distress syndrome was higher in low birth weight neonates with multiple pregnancy, fifth minute APGAR score <7, caesarean section delivery, prematurity, and birth weight <1500g.
mod_finding: Caesarean section delivery was associated with a lower risk of respiratory distress syndrome.
